ja: 「機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY」の主人公機が1/100スケールでキット化。上半身、下半身は完全変形が可能で、さらに今シリーズ初のコアスプレンダーの変形も実現。バックパックの主翼は上下に可動し、尾翼も下方向への折り畳みが可能。変形時の各ポイントにストッパー機構を採用、変形後でもしっかりとしたフォルムで飾ることが可能。主人公「シン・アスカ」のキャラクタープレートが付属。
en: The main character of "Mobile Suit GundamSEED DESTINY" is now a 1/100 scale kit. The upper and lower bodies can be completely transformed, and for the first time in this series, Core Splendor can also be transformed. The main wings of the backpack can move up and down, and the tail can also be folded downward. Adopting a stopper mechanism at each point during transformation, it is possible to display it in a firm form even after transformation. A character plate of the main character "Shin Asuka" is included.
